name: stigsim
description: A browser-based stigmergy simulator for exploring how ant colonies solve mazes.

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:app && pnpm test:highway && pnpm test:presets && pnpm test:replay && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:server && pnpm test:maze-memory
scripts.test:app: tsx --test src/modes/delivery/*.test.ts src/routes.test.ts src/modes/war/*.test.ts src/modes/model-ant/*.test.ts src/modes/model-war/*.test.ts src/modes/coordination-lab/*.test.ts src/modes/protocol-lab/*.test.ts src/modes/strategy-lab/*.test.ts src/modes/onboarding/*.test.ts
scripts.test:server: pnpm --dir server exec tsx --test src/degraded-status.test.ts src/fixed-step.test.ts src/infinite-mode.equivalence.test.ts src/sim.equivalence.test.ts src/sim.persistence.test.ts src/sim.phero-bookkeeping.test.ts src/sim.starvation.test.ts src/security.test.ts src/transport.test.ts src/war-agent.test.ts src/war.test.ts src/war.integration.test.ts src/ws.integration.test.ts src/model-ant.test.ts src/swarm-ant.test.ts src/protocol-lab.test.ts src/model-war.test.ts src/maze-memory-preview.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir packages/sim-core typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/sim-trace typecheck && pnpm --dir server typecheck && tsc -p scripts/highway/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.strategy.json && tsc -p tsconfig.maze-memory.json
